name: zai-coding-plan-global-multi
description: Z.ai GLM Coding Plan with multiple API keys for load distribution. Each account gets its own group. Useful when you have several subscriptions with limited per-key quota.
keyInstructions: Subscribe to the GLM Coding Plan at https://z.ai/subscribe and create API keys at https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list. For each account, provide the key when prompted. Keys are stored separately in VS Code's keystore.
